chains.title: Put your camp to work
chains.limits: Tool use measures dry soil or sand. A work surface receives items; it does not unlock shaping. Machine batches use the declared recipe ledger, not simulated chemistry.

steps: In Skills, follow Go to tool. Pick it up with E, or equip it from your bag.
Choose Study tool / Inspect. The saved study goes in your own journal.
Equip your gathering tool. Find dry soil or sand near the tool location shown in Skills.
Aim at the ground and use the tool. A supported removal above zero earns Gathering by hand.
Find Work table in Recipes, or make another supported surface of at least 0.1 m².
Check supplies, then Make. The new table receives items with Place; it does not perform shaping.
In Skills, choose a machine with a supported batch and inputs available.
Move near it, face it, turn it on and choose Watch next batch. Stay until an actual saved batch is recorded.
An empty intake needs supplies. Watching alone cannot finish this step.
